verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow platform with a Web UI and a Cloud service, so a built-in assistant is a fair thing to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to. The AI material covers SDK integrations for building and orchestrating your own agents (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK, AgentCore workers) and an llms.txt index for outside LLMs, not an assistant built into the product.
